name: oci-skills
description: Tenancy-agnostic Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) administration skill pack for Claude Code — one safety-first core, ten admin domains, ships no OCIDs/IPs/secrets.

plugins.name: oci-administrator
plugins.description: Safety-first OCI administration: IAM, Security & Compliance, Observability & Database, Autonomous Database, Networking & Compute, Cost (FinOps), Log Analytics, Resource Manager, Data Safe, and Events & Functions — plus a project lifecycle orchestrator and a Stage 0 solution-design front-end. Grounded in official Oracle docs (Open Knowledge Format) and routed against the upstream oracle/skills collection. Slash commands work by named context (friendly name -> profile + compartment + region) instead of raw OCIDs; every mutation is preflighted, redacted, and confirmation-gated.
